row: Dr. Neubardt & Dr. Stern ---The Neuro-Ortho Team---

About 90 percent of people with a cervical herniated disc (slipped disc) diagnosis get better without needing surgery. The more you know about your condition, the easier it will be for you to improve. To help, Board-Certified MD spine specialists treating herniated discs for over 20 years present videos on everything you need to know about a slipped disc, from diagnosis to non-surgical and surgical treatment options. 

Learn what a cervical disc herniation is and what the symptoms are. Find out how to avoid surgery, how to control the pain and when the condition is an emergency. Explore Non-Surgical Treatments in a playlist of videos covering every type available, from medications to physical therapy to Chinese Medicine. In the Surgical Treatments playlist, watch a surgical walk-through video – a must see for anyone planning surgery for a cervical herniated disc. 

If you like the videos, tell us! Leave a comment. Subscribe to our channel. To see a video on a topic not covered, ask.
